title: Final Fantasy XIV Game Band The Primals' Bassist Eikichi Iwai Dies
content:
Iwai had just performed a concert with the band during the game's Fan Festival event in Tokyo on November 1.

The Primals, led by the composer and sound director of Final Fantasy XIV Masayoshi Soken, have performed official cover music from Final Fantasy XIV since 2014. They have released multiple albums for the series and have performed in events, including the game's own official Fan Festivals.

The members include (pictured right from left to right) Michael-Christopher Koji Fox (vocalist and game's localizer, translator, and lyricist), Iwai (bassist), Masayoshi Soken (guitarist, vocalist, and game's composer), Tetsuya Tachibana (drummer), and GUNN (guitarist).

Square Enix released Final Fantasy XIV Online for personal computers in September 2010. Square Enix has since released five expansions: "Heavensward" in June 2015, "Stormblood" in June 2017, "Shadowbringers" in July 2019, "Endwalker" in December 2021, and "Dawntrail" in July 2024. The game's "Evercold" expansion will launch on February 19 for early access, and officially on February 23.
author: ANN

title: Classic Shonen Sparks Reboot Rumors After 24 Years
content:
A forgotten anime classic of the 2000s is again in the spotlight after a cryptic post, sparking reboot rumors. Reboot anime series have taken over the industry in recent years, especially with the release of The Ghost in the Shell and Magic Knight Rayearth . With the anime industry growing in massive popularity worldwide, it’s not surprising that it has long become one of the mainstream forms of media. Dozens of anime shows and movies are released each year, introducing unique stories across all kinds of genres. However, despite the newer releases, it can’t be denied that fans still have a soft spot for the 1990s and 2000s shows.

Unfortunately, a majority of the series released during that time never really adapted the entire manga. While some shows maintained a huge fan base over the years, some became known as underrated classics after they couldn’t stand the test of time. GetBackers is one such incredible series that didn’t get the adaptation it deserved. However, with the new rumors circulating around, it might be possible for this 2000s hit series to make its unexpected comeback. The rumors began after @reclaim_00 shared a teaser video hyping the return of a popular Shonen, and all hints point towards GetBackers .

GetBackers Might Be Making a Comeback With a Reboot Anime

The video was initially released in Japanese before the X handle shared an English version. The caption reads, “the strongest duo is back in action” while the video sheds more light on what to expect. It doesn’t drop the name of the series, but it drops enough hints for fans to guess the name. The video mentions that the manga was serialized in Weekly Shonen magazine and has sold over 18 million copies over the years. Not only that, but while the anime debuted in 2002, the manga began serialization in 1999, so it makes sense that the video mentioned the series was famous during the 1990s and 2000s.

The information was shared by a fairly new account that hasn’t posted anything except the announcement video. The first video got over 10 million impressions, causing enough hype before the official reveal. Fans might have to wait at least a few days or weeks to know what to expect from the series. Since the anime never fully adapted the manga, there is a possibility for a sequel instead, but a reboot adaptation after more than two decades would actually make more sense. The original anime doesn’t have catchy visuals, and it requires a modern adaptation to attract new fans.

GetBackers Deserves a Second Chance For Its Unique Story

Written by Shin Kibayashi and illustrated by Rando Ayamine, the story centers on a duo of superhuman operatives, Ginji Amano and Ban Mido, who go by the title of GetBackers . While Amano can generate electric currents with his body like an eel, Mido’s speciality lies in his mysterious Evil Eye, which allows him to create illusions in the minds of his foes. They work as a freelance repossession team based in Shinjuku, Tokyo, as most of their missions revolve around the lost or stolen items of their clients.

The duo has an exceptionally high success rate, and they undertake varying jobs. Thanks to their flawless record, all kinds of clients seek their aid. It goes without saying that the duo wouldn’t turn anyone down because they are broke. Their targets often range from ordinary personal belongings to advanced weaponry, but the story takes a drastic turn when they get into a more dangerous situation than they bargained for. As their troubles continue, the truth behind their complex pasts slowly begins to unravel.

Head down to the comments to tell us if you are excited for the anime to return. Or you could tell us your favorite GetBackers moment.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 Preview Continues Fight Against Megicula
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 7 (Episode 177 overall) ahead of its November 14 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Valkyrie Dress Noelle following Episode 6. The official Episode 7 “Beyond Never Giving Up” synopsis:

Noelle and the others are unable to use their magic freely due to the Curse-Warding Magic of the highest-ranking devil, Megicula. Even Gaja’s life-risking suicide attack is blocked, leaving them in a desperate situation with no way out. Just then, Asta and Luck arrive. They prevent the worst from happening and launch a renewed offensive against Megicula. As an intense battle rages between Megicula and the Magic Knights, someone suddenly descends onto the battlefield…

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!
author: Anime Corner

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Star Confirms English Dub Will Be Newer Than You Think
content:
Dragon Ball Super is about to kick off the official English dub release for its new remake anime series, and one of the stars behind it all has confirmed that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is going to be much newer than fans might expect. When Dragon Ball Super: Beerus was first announced to be a newly enhanced version of the original TV anime series , it was touted to feature new animation, new cuts, and more. But unfortunately it’s been revealed that there haven’t been many new lines recorded for the series at this point.

Stars of the original Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Japanese language release revealed that they did not record any new lines for their part of the new series , so fans had been wondering whether or not this would be the same case for the English dub launch. But as Goku voice star Sean Schemmel spoke about during a panel at Collect-A-Con Houston 2026 this past weekend ( as spotted by Anime Secrets on YouTube ), the English voice cast has all returned and are indeed providing new voice work for its release.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus English Dub Will Feature New Voice Work

“I’ve been working my ass off on it,” Schemmel stated when asked about Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ new English dub release. “I don’t want to go in too much detail because I’m not supposed to…there’s a good amount of original audio being pulled from the edits, but then there’s new stuff which I’m voicing fresh all last week and tomorrow and coming up and so we’re very committed to giving you guys a killer version of Beerus .” As Schemmel further confirmed, the entire cast is committed to this new version , “Crunchyroll’s committed. Toei is committed. The whole cast is here.”

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ English dub release will begin streaming with Crunchyroll on November 12th at 8:00AM PT, and new episodes will then be releasing on a weekly basis from then on for fans in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Latin America. While the Japanese release has been featuring older audio, and the dub will as well, thankfully it has been confirmed that there will be some brand new materials for fans of the dub to enjoy when it kicks off its own run.

What Does This Mean Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ Future?

If Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be featuring new English dubbed audio, then there’s a chance that there might be other new materials yet to be seen in the remake anime’s release as well. With the new series confirmed to be tackling the Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs next, there might be more surprises than expected even if the series is using older audio. The anime has revealed extended versions of fights and other moments seen so far, and at least the dub has confirmed it will offer new materials soon.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has reached the climax of the Battle of Gods arc with its latest episode, but it’s yet to be revealed how many episodes it will be running for before it ends. With two more arcs to go, it’s likely we’ll see it air through the Fall and perhaps even through the Winter 2027 anime schedule before it wraps. But are you going to be checking out Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ English dub release? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – Anime Secrets

title: Dark Crunchyroll Fantasy Confirms Season 2 Spring Return After 4 Years With New Look
content:
A dark fantasy anime that you can now find streaming with Crunchyroll has now set a Spring release for its return next year, and its second season has dropped a new look at its comeback after four long years. Dark fantasy anime releases have become a lot more popular in the last few years especially as the non-Isekai projects tend to stand out even more so than the rest. But there’s one that’s been a hidden gem that has gone under the radar for the past few years.

The anime adaptation for Ichika Isshiki and fame’s Berserk of Gluttony light novel series originally made its debut back in 2023, and the series did go under the radar for its first season. But now it’s set to make its comeback for its second season next year with a new wave of episodes hitting this Spring. Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 is finally set to return to Crunchyroll , and has dropped a new poster teasing the coming episodes that you can check out below.

Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Confirms Spring 2027 Release

Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 has revealed with this latest update that it will be making its debut sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. The new episodes will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll outside of Japan when they hit, and that’s currently where you can catch up with everything that has happened in the first season so far. It’s also set to have a returning production staff too with Tetsuya Yanagisawa and Kenichi Ishikura directing the new season for ACGT, Mariko Kunisawa returning to provide the scripts, and Takafumi Furusawa providing the character designs.

Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 will also feature a returning voice cast with Ryota Osaka as Fate Graphite, Tomokazu Seki as Greed, Hisako Tojo as Roxy Heart, Misato Matsuoka as Myne, Hitomi Sekine as Eris, and Takehito Koyasu as Aaron all confirmed to reprise their respective roles thus far. No concrete release date has been set for the new episodes as of this time, unfortunately, but that also leaves you plenty of time to catch up with everything that’s happened. There’s also an English dub for it available too if you prefer to see it that way.

What to Know for Berserk of Gluttony

Berserk of Gluttony is set in a fantasy world where every person is born with an innate skill. Fate is born with a skill that seems useless at first as he’s incredibly weak, but soon he discovers that it can make him stronger than ever. When he stumbles on a dark weapon named Greed, Fate now finds himself stuck in a cycle where he needs to kill as many monsters as he can in order to keep his growing hunger at bay. It makes for an interesting dynamic that’s sure to develop further with the new season.

Berserk of Gluttony really did go under the radar when it first hit back in 2023, and it was due to all of the competition surrounding it at the time. Unfortunately that’s looking to be the same case here as the next season is coming during an incredibly packed 2027 of new anime releases, so we’ll have to see how it all works out. Are you looking forward to Berserk of Gluttony Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Crunchyroll to Stream Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms 2nd Season Anime
content:
The second season will debut in January 2027.

Ryōta Iwasaki and Yū Serizawa reprise their roles as Medaka Kuroiwa and Mona Kawai, respectively.

Yoshiaki Okumura returns to direct the second season at Synergy SP . Yoriko Tomita ( The Elusive Samurai , My Dress-Up Darling two seasons, Senpai is an Otokonoko ) is in charge of series scripts, replacing Kazuyuki Fudeyasu . Mayumi Watanabe is again designing the characters, Nozomi Nakatani ( Too Cute Crisis , The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife ) joins Noriyoshi Konuma from the first season as sound director, Akiyuki Tateyama also returns to compose the music, and Aiko Yamagami returns as color designer. Shinichirō Nagano ( Mr. Villain's Day Off , A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai ) is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Tetsuya Nishimura , and Hiroki Matsumoto ( Gugure! Kokkuri-san , The Ossan Newbie Adventurer ) is the new art director, replacing Masakazu Miyake .

The anime's first season premiered in January 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Kodansha USA Publishing releases the manga in English digitally and physically . The company describes the story:

Mona is the cutest girl in school, and she knows it. In fact, she's worked hard to make her high school debut successful. But no matter what she does, she can't seem to catch the eye of stone-cold stoic Medaka Kuroiwa—but she's not about to give up that easy. Medaka, on the other hand, has been raised at a temple and was told to never become close to women. Who will win in this heated battle of wills?

Kuze ( Tokyo Ravens: Sword of Song ) first published the manga as a one-shot story in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in December 2020. The manga started its full serialization in the magazine in May 2021. Kodansha published the manga's first compiled book volume in Japan in August 2021, and the 26th volume shipped on October 16.
author: ANN

title: Falcom Reveals Sequel for The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon Game
content:
The game launched on January 15 for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam . NIS America originally scheduled the game for a fall 2025 release, but delayed it along with the announcement of the Switch 2 version. The game launched in Japan for Switch, PS5, and PS4 in September 2024, The game got a release on PC via Steam in Asia in January 2025.

The company describes the story:

Van Arkride and the members of Arkride Solutions are back, and this time the future of the entire Zemurian continent is at stake! The people of Zemuria await the launch of humanity's first foray into space with bated breath. A sudden invitation from Marduk to cooperate in a high-tech training exercise sets Van, Ashen Chevalier Rean Schwarzer, and Father Kevin Graham on a collision course with the secrets at the very core of Zemuria. Their paths may diverge, but the ultimate question remains the same: Just what lies beyond the edge of the horizon?

title: New Solo Leveling Contender Drops New Trailer Ahead of 2027 Release – Watch Now
content:
Solo Leveling has had a lot of new anime releases coming for its crown over the last couple of years, and now a new contender is entering the fray when it kicks off its run next January. There are a number of major Webtoon anime adaptations now in the works as Crunchyroll kicked off a new partnership with HAYATE and WEBTOON Entertainment’s LINE Digital Frontier Corporation to produce even more works with the hopes that they will find as much breakout success as hits like Solo Leveling has.

Shin Noah and Bill K.’s SSS-Class Revival Hunter already has a huge fanbase with the original Korean webcomic series , and it’s likely to gain even more popularity if its upcoming anime can find the right audience when it hits. Making its debut next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, you can check out the new trailer for SSS-Class Revival Hunter below as it shows off its new ending theme.

SSS-Class Revival Hunter Releases New Trailer for January 2027 Launch

SSS-Class Revival Hunter is currently scheduled to make its debut next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , but it has yet to confirm a concrete release date as of this time. This new trailer reveals the ending theme for the new anime titled “Fading” as performed by THE SPELLBOUND and BOOM BOOM SATELLITES. The new series will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll worldwide excluding Asia, with availability in the Indian subcontinent, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia when the new episodes hit. There’s still much more to be revealed about the production staff and cast for the new anime too.

All that’s been revealed thus far is that Hiroaki Sakurai will be directing the series for STUDIO fu. with Sayuri Oba providing the scripts, Takahiro Yoshimatsu providing the character designs, and Ryo Kawasaki and Tomoyuki Kono will be composing the music. The voice cast confirmed thus far include the likes of Takeo Otsuka as Gongja Kim, Satoshi Hino as Sword Emperor, Toshiki Masuda as Flame Emperor, Megumi Han as Witch of the Black Dragon, Sayaka Kinoshita as Paladin, Risa Shimizu as Countess, Makoto Furukawa as Poisonous Viper, Natsumi Fujiwara as Inquisitor, Yuka Iguchi as Master Alchemist, and Shunsuke Sakuya as Blade Saint.

Why You Should Keep an Eye Out for SSS-Class Revival Hunter

SSS-Class Revival Hunter has a strong position to kick off the new year of anime on the right foot as it offers yet another potential anime that could really make waves when it hits. When a mysterious tower appears and hunters begin making their way through it, Gongja Kim is one of the weakest hunters who can do nothing but be envious of the strongest, the Flame Hunter. But Gongja gets some unexpected help, and only needs to die to activate the latent power now within him. But naturally, something like that is much easier said than done.

SSS-Class Revival Hunter has a similar vibe to Solo Leveling in that the world of hunting has steadily taken over the real world , but there’s likely going to be much more hidden underneath all of that when it makes its debut. It’s part of why the franchise has been such a hit with fans of the webcomic so far, but now it’s likely going to make waves when it hits the big stage. How are you feeling about SSS-Class Revival Hunter so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: New Made in Abyss Movie Confirms Streaming Release Platform With New Trailer – Watch
content:
Made in Abyss is coming back to screens with a brand new movie , and has now confirmed a streaming release that fans will be able to look forward to next year. Akihito Tsukushi’s Made in Abyss has been a monumental success over the past decade thanks to the fact that the dark series ended up reaching a whole new level of popularity with its TV anime adaptation. That anime went on for multiple seasons, and has even had a few feature film releases under its belt. Now it’s coming back for more.

Made in Abyss has kicked off a whole new trilogy of feature films continuing the story from its previous entry, and Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery is the first major entry now working its way through theaters in Japan this Fall. Fans in international territories had been waiting for their chance to see the new movie in action too, and now it’s been confirmed that HIDIVE will be exclusively streaming the new film outside of Japan in 2027. Check out the new trailer for it below.

Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Movie Confirms HIDIVE Streaming Release

Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery will be making its streaming debut with HIDIVE sometime next year, but a concrete release date has yet to be announced as of this time. The film will be having its North American premiere on December 5th as part of a special screening at Anime Frontier, and is the first in a new trilogy of films planned for the franchise with the second film now confirmed to be in the works. The main cast from the previous entries are confirmed to return too with Mariya Ise as Reg, Miyu Tomita as Riko, Shiori Izawa as Nanachi, and Misaki Kuno as Faputa.

Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery is directed by Masayuki Kojima for Kinema Citrus with Hideyuki Kurata handling the script for the films, Kazuchika Kise and Yuka Kuroda handling the character designs, and Kevin Penkin composing the music. The composer also contributed to the theme song for the film titled “Chain of the Abyss,” with Mori Calliope. Several new faces have been added to the voice cast for the coming trilogy as well with the first of this new group making their debut in the new film.

What’s Next for Made in Abyss ?

New additions joining the cast for Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery include Sumire Morohoshi as Tepaste, Takanori Hoshino as Cravagli, Nana Mizuki as Srajo, Akeno Watanabe as Nishagora, Shunsuke Takeuchi as Yataramar, Nao Toyama as Sherumi, and Yume Miyamoto as Menae. Given that this is the first of a newly planned trilogy, it’s going to have a lot for fans to dig into. So you should probably take the time to go back and check out the first two seasons of the TV series now streaming with HIDIVE in the meantime.

Made in Abyss also continued with a feature film entry, Dawn of the Deep Soul , and you’ll want to be sure to catch up with everything to make sure you can jump back into it. Made in Abyss doesn’t really hold anyone’s hand as Riko and Reg descend further into the titular Abyss, and it’s not going to be holding back when it hits. Are you excited to see the new Made in Abyss movie soon? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter New Trailer Previews Ending Theme Song by THE SPELLBOUND x BOOM BOOM SATELLITES
content:
SSS-Class Revival Hunter anime has released a new trailer featuring additional footage and a preview of its ending theme song “Fading” performed by THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES.

The anime was previously announced for January 2027, with Crunchyroll set to stream it.

THE SPELLBOUND x BOOM BOOM SATELLITES commented on the ending theme:

“With the opening guitar riff, we wanted to capture the exhilarating feeling of breaking through even a predetermined fate. Through the melody and upbeat electronic sound, we wanted to express the refreshing sensation of continuing to rise. We poured into this song the energetic impulse of continuing to change both yourself and the world the more you live. We hope it can boost the world of SSS-Class Revival Hunter.”

The main voice cast includes Takeo Otsuka as Kim Gongja and Satoshi Hino as the Sword Emperor. You can see the full cast below.

• Takeo Otsuka as Kim Gongja

• Satoshi Hino as Sword Emperor

• Toshiki Masuda as Flame Emperor

• Megumi Han as Witch of the Black Dragon

• Sayaka Kinoshita as Paladin

• Risa Shimizu as Countess

• Makoto Furukawa as Poisonous Viper

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Inquisitor

• Yuka Iguchi as Master Alchemist

• Shunsuke Sakuya as Blade Saint

You can watch the new trailer below.

Hiroaki Sakurai, known for The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. , is directing the anime at STUDIO fu. Sayuri Oba is handling the scripts, while Takahiro Yoshimatsu is serving as character designer. Ryu Kawasaki and Tomoyuki Kono are in charge of the music.

SSS-Class Revival Hunter follows Kim Gongja, an F-rank Hunter who obtains an ability that allows him to return to 24 hours before his death. With the Sword Emperor, a former top Hunter who now follows him as a ghost, Gongja begins climbing through the Hunter ranks while repeatedly using death to alter his path.

Crunchyroll will stream SSS-Class Revival Hunter in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, the Indian Subcontinent, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Singapore.

The original Korean webcomic by Shin Noah and illustrated by Bill K debuted in December 2020 and has released 154 episodes to date. An English-language edition is available through Tapas, though Kakao Entertainment is shutting Tapas down by the end of the year.
